capabilities.label: Storefront/themes
capabilities.detail: any WordPress theme (Storefront + block/FSE themes), WooCommerce Blocks (product grid blocks — Bestsellers/Top-Rated/New/On-Sale/Hand-Picked/category), Gutenberg + page-builder (Elementor) compatibility, full site editing

capabilities.label: Catalog
capabilities.detail: product types — simple/variable/grouped/external-affiliate/virtual/downloadable, unlimited products, categories/tags/attributes, Product Bundles/Composite Products/Product Add-Ons (extensions), custom fields, reviews & ratings, related/upsell/cross-sell

capabilities.label: Cart/checkout
capabilities.detail: Cart & Checkout Blocks (no-code editing), guest checkout, coupons at checkout, Store API (headless cart/checkout), express-checkout buttons

capabilities.label: Payments
capabilities.detail: WooPayments (native, Stripe-powered), Stripe/PayPal/Square/Amazon Pay, Apple/Google Pay, 140+ region-specific gateways, BACS bank transfer/cheque/cash on delivery, recurring payments

capabilities.label: Promotions
capabilities.detail: coupons (%/fixed cart/fixed product/free shipping), usage limits & restrictions, Smart Coupons & Dynamic Pricing (extensions), on-sale pricing

capabilities.label: Inventory
capabilities.detail: stock management, low/out-of-stock notifications, backorders, stock status/hold, multi-location via extensions

capabilities.label: Multi-channel
capabilities.detail: Google for WooCommerce (Listings & Ads), Meta, Pinterest, TikTok, Amazon/eBay (CedCommerce/Codisto), Point of Sale (Square, POS extensions)

capabilities.label: B2B
capabilities.detail: via extensions — B2B for WooCommerce, Wholesale Suite, Request-a-Quote, customer-specific/role-based pricing

capabilities.label: Internationalization
capabilities.detail: 24+ core translations, multilingual via WPML/Polylang/MultilingualPress, multi-currency + currency switcher (extensions), geolocation

capabilities.label: SEO/marketing
capabilities.detail: WordPress SEO (Yoast/Rank Math), WooCommerce Marketing hub, email marketing (Mailchimp/MailPoet/Klaviyo), AutomateWoo (marketing automation, abandoned cart, follow-ups), GA, product feeds, reviews

capabilities.label: Headless/REST
capabilities.detail: WooCommerce REST API + Store API + webhooks, open-source PHP with hooks/filters, fully headless-capable, self-hostable ("complete ownership")
features: WooCommerce REST API + Store API + webhooks

capabilities.label: Extensions
capabilities.detail: WooCommerce Marketplace (700+ extensions) + entire WordPress plugin ecosystem (59,000+), open-source & extensible, Jetpack (security/performance/backups)
features: WooCommerce Marketplace (700+ extensions) + entire WordPress plugin ecosystem (59,000+)

capabilities.label: Analytics
capabilities.detail: WooCommerce Analytics (revenue/orders/products/categories/coupons/taxes/downloads/stock/customers reports), GA integration, Jetpack site stats

capabilities.label: Shipping
capabilities.detail: WooCommerce Shipping (discounted USPS/DHL labels, print at home), flat rate/free shipping/local pickup, shipping zones & classes, real-time carrier rates + Table Rate / ShipStation (extensions), tax calc (WooCommerce Tax, Avalara)
features: WooCommerce Shipping (discounted USPS/DHL labels, print at home)
real-time carrier rates + Table Rate / ShipStation (extensions)
